verses.raw: O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying<sup foot_note=254193>1</sup> or in a state of janābah,<sup foot_note=254194>2</sup> except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body]. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women [i.e., had sexual intercourse] and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it]. Indeed, Allāh is ever Pardoning<sup foot_note=254195>3</sup> and Forgiving.
